name: Delivery Not Guaranteed
desc:
Centuries after the apocalypse, civilization has started anew using blimps, airships, and other such aerostats as its main form of transportation. Settlements are few and far between, and they each posses little resources. People like you capitalize off of their need for foreign resources by trading packages across the skies with different sorts of airships. However, due to rampant piracy and occasional natural disasters, the job isn't always easy.

Pls try my new game: https://www.roblox.com/games/84604558470493/Going-Down

scripts.title: DNG AUTO FARM AND TELEPORTER
scripts.script:
--// Rayfield Loader
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))();

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "blimp game",
    Icon = 0,
    LoadingTitle = "ts loading",
    LoadingSubtitle = "by relaby",
    ShowText = "Rayfield",
    Theme = "Default",
    ToggleUIKeybind = "K",
    DisableRayfieldPrompts = true,
    DisableBuildWarnings = false,
    ConfigurationSaving = {
        Enabled = false,
        FolderName = nil,
        FileName = "Big Hub"
    },
    Discord = {
        Enabled = false,
        Invite = "noinvitelink",
        RememberJoins = true
    },
    KeySystem = false,
    KeySettings = {
        Title = "Untitled",
        Subtitle = "Key System",
        Note = "No method of obtaining the key is provided",
        FileName = "Key",
        SaveKey = true,
        GrabKeyFromSite = false,
        Key = {"Hello"}
    }
})

--// Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local HRP = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local backPallet = character:FindFirstChild("BackPallet")
local RemoteEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RemoteEvent6_BOX")

local bellPrompt = workspace.NewGoldegon.DeliverStation.BellRing:WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
local DeliverPrompt = workspace.Ties.Deliver:WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")

-- Positions
local bellCFrame = CFrame.new(-4892.76514, 801.97998, 3876.62891)
local dropPos = Vector3.new(4232.9, 671.3, -3103.07)

-- Teleports (Goldegon moved 60 studs left)
local teleportLocations = {
    ["Luisville"] = CFrame.new(-44, 950.25, 0),
    ["New Goldegon"] = CFrame.new(-5650, 802.5, 3853), -- shifted left 60 studs
    ["Bloomsville"] = CFrame.new(-3494, 1802, -1835),
    ["Huffencrag"] = CFrame.new(-10978, 1081, -2000),
    ["Farmers Rock"] = CFrame.new(-1536, 642, 174),
    ["Greensburg"] = CFrame.new(4650, 700, -3112),
    ["Horn Swamp"] = CFrame.new(-1201, 862, 4599),
    ["Kinkade"] = CFrame.new(-2512, 1242.5, -4268),
    ["Lavafork Fort"] = CFrame.new(1330, 1512, -3242),
    ["Lichanton"] = CFrame.new(3396, 886, 2048),
    ["Mount Tyranny"] = CFrame.new(268, 3322, -5230),
    ["Mushroom Mountain"] = CFrame.new(3534, 1846, 5054),
    ["Spruceville"] = CFrame.new(1642.5, 1402, -932),
    ["Vinsburg"] = CFrame.new(-490.48, 803.5, -2637.98)
}

-- Utility
local function getNearestPrompt(pos)
    local best, dist = nil, math.huge
    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and obj.Enabled then
            local parent = obj.Parent
            if parent:IsA("BasePart") then
                local d = (parent.Position - pos).Magnitude
                if d < dist then
                    dist = d
                    best = obj
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function firePromptSmart(prompt)
    if prompt.HoldDuration > 0 then
        fireproximityprompt(prompt, 0)
        task.wait(prompt.HoldDuration + 0.05)
        fireproximityprompt(prompt, 1)
    else
        fireproximityprompt(prompt)
    end
end

local validBoxNames = { Box=true, Package=true, Crate=true, DeliveryBox=true, Cargo=true }

local function getBoxOwnerName(box)
    local info = box:FindFirstChild("Info")
    if not info then return nil end
    local owner = info:FindFirstChild("Owner")
    if not owner then return nil end
    return owner.Text or owner.Value or owner.String
end

local function getBoxPrompt(box)
    for _, child in ipairs(box:GetDescendants()) do
        if child:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
            return child
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function getClosestBoxes(n)
    local boxes = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and validBoxNames[obj.Name] then
            if getBoxOwnerName(obj) == player.Name then
                local prompt = getBoxPrompt(obj)
                if prompt then
                    table.insert(boxes, {
                        part = obj,
                        prompt = prompt,
                        dist = (obj.Position - HRP.Position).Magnitude
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(boxes, function(a,b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
    return {unpack(boxes, 1, math.min(n, #boxes))}
end

local function teleportAbove(part)
    HRP.CFrame = CFrame.new(part.Position + Vector3.new(0,4,0))
end

-- AUTO FARM
local running = false

local function tp(cf)
    HRP.CFrame = cf + Vector3.new(0,5,0)
    task.wait(0.3)
end

local function buyBoxes()
    tp(teleportLocations["New Goldegon"])
    local prompt = getNearestPrompt(HRP.Position)
    if prompt then firePromptSmart(prompt) end
end

local function sellBoxes()
    tp(teleportLocations["Luisville"])
    local prompt = getNearestPrompt(HRP.Position)
    if prompt then firePromptSmart(prompt) end
end

local function ringBell()
    HRP.CFrame = bellCFrame
    task.wait(0.4)
    firePromptSmart(bellPrompt)
end

local function pickupBoxes()
    local boxes = getClosestBoxes(3)
    for _, box in ipairs(boxes) do
        teleportAbove(box.part)
        firePromptSmart(box.prompt)
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
end

local function runSequence()
    while running do
        buyBoxes()
        ringBell()
        pickupBoxes()
        sellBoxes()
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end

local function startLoop()
    if not running then
        running = true
        task.spawn(runSequence)
    end
end

local function stopLoop()
    running = false
end

-- UI
local homeTab = Window:CreateTab("", "home")
local playerTab = Window:CreateTab("", "user")
local settingsTab = Window:CreateTab("", "settings")

homeTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Auto Farm Boxes",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        if v then startLoop() else stopLoop() end
    end
})

homeTab:CreateDropdown({
    Name = "Teleports",
    Options = {"Luisville","New Goldegon","Huffencrag","Bloomsville","Farmers Rock","Greensburg","Horn Swamp","Kinkade","Lavafork Fort","Lichanton","Mount Tyranny","Mushroom Mountain","Spruceville","Vinsburg"},
    CurrentOption = {"Luisville"},
    Callback = function(opt)
        local cf = teleportLocations[opt[1]]
        if cf then tp(cf) end
    end
})

local teleportDropdown = playerTab:CreateDropdown({
    Name = "Select user",
    Options = {},
    CurrentOption = {},
    Callback = function() end
})

local function refreshPlayers()
    local list = {}
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= player then table.insert(list, plr.Name) end
    end
    teleportDropdown:Refresh(list)
end

refreshPlayers()
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(refreshPlayers)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(refreshPlayers)

playerTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Teleport to Player",
    Callback = function()
        local name = teleportDropdown.CurrentOption[1]
        local plr = Players:FindFirstChild(name)
        if plr and plr.Character then
            local root = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then HRP.CFrame = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,5,0) end
        end
    end
})

settingsTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Anti-AFK",
    Callback = function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZEXT512/AntiAfkXs/refs/heads/main/Anti"))()
    end
})

settingsTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "FPS Booster",
    Callback = function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CasperFlyModz/discord.gg-rips/main/FPSBooster.lua"))()
    end
})

settingsTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Disable 3d render",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        RunService:Set3dRenderingEnabled(not v)
    end
})
